patches.summary: Default the {userId} template var to "me" instead of a placeholder outside verify mode.
patches.reason: Every Gmail path is /users/{userId}/...; "me" is the only value that makes sense for a personal OAuth token, so the generated placeholder made every request 404 until GMAIL_USER_ID was set by hand.
patches.validated_outcome: users-profile me and all generated endpoint commands resolve against the live API without GMAIL_USER_ID set.

patches.summary: Treat a refresh-token-only config as incomplete so the access token still merges from the credentials file.
patches.reason: hasCompleteCredentialFields returned true when only RefreshToken was set, so config.Load skipped the credentials-file merge and left AccessToken empty; the generated TestPartialConfigCredentialsMergeMissingFields failed out of the box.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/config ./internal/cliutil passes; partial-config merge test green.

patches.summary: Bare `sync` delegates to the hand-authored mailbox pull flow instead of an empty resource loop.
patches.reason: messages.list returns bare ids, so the generic per-resource sync could never hydrate a useful local store; the emitted defaultSyncResources was empty and `sync` was a runtime no-op while framework hints still told users to run it.
patches.validated_outcome: sync with no flags mirrored 1262 live messages, 0 skipped; dogfood's sync-no-op warning cleared.

patches.summary: Populate the emitted resourceReadPaths/resourceReadConfigs maps for messages, threads, labels, drafts, and filters.
patches.reason: The generator emitted empty maps, leaving `tail` with zero valid resources (a runtime no-op) and `export`'s batch mode without a resolvable list path.
patches.validated_outcome: verify's resource-path checks for tail and export cleared; verify pass rate 100%.

patches.summary: Register root-level novel commands via guarded direct rootCmd.AddCommand instead of the addNovelCommandIfAbsent indirection.
patches.reason: The indirection hides registrations from every static command-tree consumer, so dogfood's depth check reported `schedule send` as registered under drafts/messages and the scorecard missed the novel leaves.
patches.validated_outcome: dogfood novel-feature depth mismatch cleared; 6/6 novel features detected.

patches.summary: Point tail's help example at a real resource instead of the nonexistent "events" resource.
patches.reason: The generated example referenced a resource this spec does not define, so copy-pasting it failed.
